info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v4-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows merchants to efficiently remove items from a user's ecommerce shopping cart. By utilizing this resource, developers can manage the contents of a cart, ensuring that users have an accurate representation of their current selections. Typical consumers of this API include ecommerce platforms and mobile applications that provide shopping functionalities. This operation enhances user experience by allowing for quick adjustments to cart contents before proceeding to checkout.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the shopping cart.
delete.description: This operation allows a user to remove a specified item from their shopping cart, updating the cart's content accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details of the cart item to be removed. Please provide the necessary information in accordance with the defined schema.

200.description: The item was successfully removed from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveRequest.description: The request body for the cart item removal operation. This should typically specify the item to be removed in the cart.
